# LoadedMods <Badge type="info" text="class" />

<p class="api-meta">Namespace <code>Lustral</code> · Assembly <code>Lustral.Api</code></p>

The mods Lustral has loaded in the current session, including libraries, in load order. A mod's dependencies and optional dependencies are always loaded before it, so from the mod's constructor onward, `Mods.IsLoaded("other.mod")` indicates whether an optional dependency is present.
